en: A single bolt of lightning is five times hotter than the visible surface of our sun.
It takes nature up to 500 years to naturally form just one single inch of fertile topsoil.
Pumice is the only type of rock that can float on water because it is full of trapped air bubbles.
A typical fluffy cumulus cloud can weigh over one million pounds because it holds so much liquid water.
Venus spins backwards compared to most other planets, meaning the sun actually rises in the west there.
Neutron stars are so incredibly dense that just one teaspoon of their material would weigh over a billion tons.
The moon is slowly drifting away from Earth at a measurable rate of about 3.8 centimeters per year.
The 1883 eruption of Krakatoa produced the loudest sound in recorded history, heard over 3,000 miles away.
Typhoon Haiyan, one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded, had maximum sustained winds of 195 miles per hour.
Olympus Mons on Mars is the tallest known volcano in the solar system, standing more than twice as high as Mount Everest.
Diamonds are made of pure carbon, which is the exact same element found in soft pencil lead.
Antarctica is technically classified as a desert because it receives less than two inches of precipitation annually.
